_: Registry of every supported link switch, its purpose, readers and status. Detailed notes and decisions: docs/notes/config-history/link-switches.md.
intro: Every `?name=value` the game reads from its link, and where it reads it. Most are read once as the page loads (`src/app/linkParams.ts` for the tuning, `src/app/gameParams.ts` for the game, `src/app/viewParams.ts` for the view, `src/main.ts` for the page); a few are read where they're used. Several can be combined: `?seed=123&wave=30&creator=0`. This page is written from `config/link-switches.json`, and a test checks that file against the code.

switches.name: cold
